title: Bijectivity of the constructed open-restriction Ext maps
statement:
Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $S$ an $R$-algebra, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a scheme morphism, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $j:W\hookrightarrow X$ an open subscheme. Put $p:X_S\to X$ and $p_W:W_S\to W$ for base change to $S$, and put $F=U(M)$, $F_W=U(j^*M)$, $N=U(p^*M)$, $N_W=U(p_W^*j^*M)$, where $U$ forgets modules to abelian sheaves [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Let $k:W_S\to X_S$ be the map with $p\circ k=j\circ p_W$ and equal projections to $\operatorname{Spec}S$, and let $J=j^{-1}$, $J'=k^{-1}$, $G=p^{-1}$, $G_W=p_W^{-1}$ [lem-pc-open-restriction-data]. Write $L_W,L_{\top,W}$ for the represented free abelian sheaves [lem-pc-free-mayer-vietoris-short-exact]. For any sheaf isomorphisms $e:JL_W\cong L_{\top,W}$, $d:JF\cong F_W$, $e':J'GL_W\cong G_WL_{\top,W}$ and $d':J'N\cong N_W$, the two specific homomorphisms
$$q_{J,e,d,n}:\operatorname{Ext}^n_X(L_W,F)\to\operatorname{Ext}^n_W(L_{\top,W},F_W),$$
$$q_{J',e',d',n}:\operatorname{Ext}^n_{X_S}(GL_W,N)\to\operatorname{Ext}^n_{W_S}(G_WL_{\top,W},N_W)$$
of [lem-pc-ext-restriction-map-calculus] are bijective for every $n\geq0$. This asserts no scalar or base-change compatibility for independently chosen isomorphisms.

source.place: Exact open extension (03DJ, 01AK), its restriction adjunction (03DI, 00A7), and localization (04J0); applying the exact Ext adjunction to represented open free sheaves.

proof.text: For an exact additive functor preserving injectives, prove by induction on n that Ext from A is preserved whenever the functor is bijective on Hom(A,F) for every F. Degree zero follows from Ext.mk₀_bijective and mapExactFunctor_mk₀. For degree n+1 choose an injective presentation of F and its short exact cokernel sequence. The original and mapped Ext covariant sequences are right exact. mapExactFunctor_comp and mapExactFunctor_extClass give commuting squares. Ext into the injective middle objects vanishes in positive degree. Apply AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_right_exact with the induction hypothesis to obtain bijectivity.

Apply this induction to inverse image of W.ι. Use preservation of injectives and restriction-Hom bijectivity for the image open, whose image is W. Compose the resulting Ext map with precomposition by e.inv and postcomposition by d.hom. Their inverse isomorphisms prove these compositions bijective.

Express k as the inverse of pullbackRightPullbackFstIso followed by pullback.snd W.ι p. Hence k is an open immersion and its opensRange equals p⁻¹W by opensRange_pullbackSnd. The proved inverse-image/free-sheaf isomorphism identifies p⁻¹L_W with L_{k(Y)}. Transport restriction-Hom bijectivity across this source isomorphism, use preservation of injectives, and apply the same induction. Compose with e′.inv and d′.hom, whose Ext maps are bijective.

proof_origin.place: K1: the exact open-restriction Ext argument implemented by injective-presentation dimension shifting, using degree-zero Hom restriction and preservation of injectives. Inverse image of represented free sheaves is proved by adjunction and Coyoneda.ext.

lean.statement:
theorem H.openRestrictionExt_bijective
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (M : X.Modules) (W : X.Opens)
    (e : (invImage W.ι).obj (H.openFreeSheaf W) ≅
      H.openFreeSheaf (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens))
    (d : (invImage W.ι).obj ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).obj ((pullback W.ι).obj M))
    (e' : (invImage (H.openBaseChangeInclusion (S := S) f W)).obj
      ((invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) f)).obj (H.openFreeSheaf W)) ≅
      (invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f))).obj
        (H.openFreeSheaf (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens)))
    (d' : (invImage (H.openBaseChangeInclusion (S := S) f W)).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).ringCatSheaf).obj
        (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (baseChangedScheme (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f)).ringCatSheaf).obj
        (baseChangedModule (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) ((pullback W.ι).obj M))) :
    (∀ n, Function.Bijective (Ext.restrictAddHom (invImage W.ι) e d n)) ∧
      (∀ n, Function.Bijective
        (Ext.restrictAddHom
          (invImage (H.openBaseChangeInclusion (S := S) f W)) e' d' n))
